reviews.text: The staff is super knowledgeable! They took really good care of my sweet bunny Peas

I absolutely love this office and everybody in it! I've heard really nice things about Dr B and she far exceeded any of my expectations. The onboarding was complete detailing everything about my bird including how often the cage is cleaned. Nobody's ever asked me that before.
They are LGBTQ friendly which I fully support. Reasoning? This doctor doesn't want anybody to feel that they can't get exceptional care for their exotic pet because of any kind of labeling.
They do things a little differently here, like putting my bird in another cage where they draw blood and holding off doing nails so the bird can calm down. Your appointment time may take a little bit longer than you expect but trust that your bird is in the best care.
very kind and caring community, helped me asap with my cockatiel
Excellent team, took great care of my little tortoise! Very happy with the professional team.
TOL saved our axolotl’s life. She had a cut that got infected and everyone jumped into action to help stop the bleeding and save her life. We are so grateful for the care given to our animal.
Always handle my pets with care, and explain everything clearly. Kind people, and they work quick and organized

Dr. B and the entire staff at Tree of Life are amazing. They take care of my chickens, hedgehog, and bearded dragon, and I’ve had consistently great experiences with them. Having several older animals can get expensive very quickly, and one of the things I appreciate most is how realistic and thoughtful they are about treatment options. I never feel like every visit automatically turns into the most expensive possible treatment plan. They explain what’s going on, talk through the options, and help me make decisions that make sense for the animal and the situation. That has built a lot of trust over the years. Ben and Johnny are awesome vet techs and have seen me at my absolute worst, including completely snot-faced after having to say goodbye to a few of my pets. Bird euthanasia can be unsettling to witness, and I really appreciate that they still allow me to be in the room and stay with my chickens through the process. Being able to be there with them means a lot to me, and the staff has always been incredibly compassionate during those difficult visits. Every staff member I’ve encountered has been kind, knowledgeable, and compassionate. When you have animals that aren’t exactly the standard dog or cat, finding a veterinary team you really trust is huge. I’m very grateful to have Dr. B and the Tree of Life team caring for my animals.

Friendly and efficient service from the reception desk to the exam room. Johnny and Dr B were both knowledgeable and nonjudgmental. They made learning how to care for my turtle simple to understand and comfortable. I will be bringing all of my exotics to Tree of Life🐢💚.
Dr. Heather Bjornebo is the best! All of the staff is so kind and I know my babies are in the best hands when I bring them in
Very professional folks.
Amazing clinic and staff!

We took our 8 year old bearded dragon into see the dr as he had some foam around his mouth and was breathing weird. The staff was absolutely incredible and helpful in diagnosing and giving us training on how we had to administer the medication.

Always great care and people at Tree of Life. Brought my Rillo in for a fecal test since he’s been acting a little off. Easy check up and test. We were out the door in just over an hour with a diagnosis of “dragon cooties,” meds and a game plan. (To be fair, they called the parasites something else all official, like flagellates)

Spicy Beardies get Burrito’d 😂
This was long overdue thank you very much. Great service and care.

I was very pleased with how efficient and friendly everyone was. Basically no wait time, the staff were all very knowledgeable and treated my bearded dragon with so much care. Gave him a towel so he would be comfortable and warm. Reasonably priced, I have no complaints.

Has definitely been my favorite vet for my reptiles. Mushu had a great checkup and Randall (Chameleon) has been seen the most and I appreciate all that Dr B and all staff do to help with my guy through our latest struggles. Each time we leave I feel more comfortable with his care and know he’s in good hands. Very accommodating to my pets needs and get me in very quickly. Talk me through any concerns and help guide me to the proper care or things I can do better. Very affordable and worth the hour drive for me! Also was very compassionate when I had to put another beardie down awhile back

Would highly recommend Tree of Life services. They helped our bunny get rid of his stubborn ear infection and everyone there is extremely knowledgeable on exotic animals. Also wanted to point out how the receptionist Allie is the most attentive receptionist we’ve ever had and was always ready to assist us with every step. Our bunny is happy and healthy thanks to them!

Dr B, and Johnny and rest of the  staff make you feel welcome,
My umbrella cockatoo they are amazing with her .Glad I pick a great team for my Lucy when she becomes ill.or if she needs a wellness check up .......they even give you great reading material to understand the needs of your exotic animal especially for first-time exotic pet owners

Thank you for all that you do ...

I went in for my frog and I have never felt so welcomed. I went in feeling like I was gonna be called a bad owner but I went came out feeling more educated on how to better take care of my baby. I plan to take all my children here, would recommend to any exotic animal owner.
I’ve been coming here for months! Staff is extremely friendly and helpful. I would highly recommend.

I took my bird to Tree of Life Exotic Pet Medical Center after she was injured. During the visit, I was told she was in severe pain, would never recover, and that euthanasia was the best option. I also asked if they could make a small cast or splint to help stabilize her leg injury, but they refused. I left feeling devastated and, unfortunately, made to feel like I wasn't acting in my pet's best interest because I wasn't ready to make that decision.

I chose to bring my bird home and provide supportive care while closely monitoring her condition. Thankfully, she went on to make a full recovery. Trust your instincts, NOT the vets, especially Dr. Heather Bjornebo.

Dr B is literally the only exotic animal vet I will personally recommend from now on. My bearded dragon - we were told was just deformed - continually had fluid building up in her neck and her poor nose would clog! Dr. B chose to be a TRUE vet and find the root cause of the fluid building up. Her compassion for animals saved my little girl from being poked and prodded! Everyone of the staff was so kind and helpful. There are vets who just study to pass the exam, then there are those who take the time to stand out by actually caring for the animals. This is Dr. B. Below are actual before and after photos of my little girl. I cannot express enough how much I appreciate Tree of Life. 1,000/10 👏
Today my breaded dragon Bob woke up happy and ready for his follow up. Thanks to all staff for todays visit yous are awesome!

If i could give them more than 5 stars, I definitely would. This has been by far my best vet experience with my reptiles. My gecko had a tail issue and they were able to get me in same day, they were able to amputate her tail and get her meds so quickly and thoughtfully. I would reccommend this vet to everyone. 10 out of 10 experience.
Thank you for your review, Allie. Your 5-star rating means a lot to our team at Tree of Life Exotic Pet Medical Center.

My son and I had a wonderful experience here. They were able to get us in quickly with our new ferret.  Everyone was extremely helpful and kind.  They were very understanding of any of our concerns.  I would highly recommend them to anyone.

To most people, she was “just a duck.” To us, she was family.

Thank you to the staff here for showing us so much kindness from the very first phone call through the hardest goodbye. You treated us with such warmth and compassion, and you were incredibly gentle with our Ducky every step of the way.

It was difficult finding a vet that would allow my husband and me to stay in the room during the euthanasia process, but your team took the time to gently explain what to expect and allowed us to make the choice ourselves. That meant more to us than I can properly put into words.

Losing a pet, no matter how small or feathered, leaves a huge space behind. Thank you for treating her life with dignity and for giving her a peaceful goodbye surrounded by love.

I would absolutely recommend your clinic to anyone needing compassionate care for their pets.

My sister-in-law's red footed tortoise had a growth on his hind leg. Tree of life was reccomended to us. The staff was great, the doctors explaind what it was and suggested surgery. He hsd the surgery and every thing was fine. I eould reccomend Tree of Life exotic animal clinic.

I brought my guinea pig in to have a large mass removed, and I was incredibly nervous about the procedure. The team did an excellent job with his surgery, and I’m so grateful for the care they showed him. A couple of weeks post-op, he’s back to his normal, happy self. They handled him with such kindness and attention, which really put me at ease. I truly appreciate their compassion and skill.

Thank you for the feedback. We take all reviews seriously; however, we have no record of a client by your name. We would appreciate the opportunity to learn more about your experience; please feel free to contact us directly.

I’ve always had dogs and cats so this was a first for me, brought my bunnies for a wellness exam and vaccines. Johnny was great and Dr. B was as well. Very knowledgeable and made the process quick and easy. I’m coming back in about 4 weeks to get my female and male bunnies spayed and neutered! I hope that goes well. I saw some negative reviews but honestly at the end of the day, as the owner, it is your responsibility that if you have a gut feeling, either go somewhere else for a second opinion or the hospital or demand your pet to be seen. Don’t get upset at the vets, they’re only human, they can’t see the future. Doctors make this mistake on human life too. Overall, great experience, I just let them do their thing and they did so gracefully. 🌷🤎 Thank you Johnny and Dr. B.
Love this place highly recommend!! This crew took great care of our lizard!!
Wonderful staff prices are definitely reasonable 😀 …

I remember being so desperate to help my little box turtle when it stopped eating and walking. I posted a message for help on social media. T.W responded by telling me to take my box turtle to Tree of Life exotic Pet Medical Center due to them being pet experts. I was a hesitant at first and for once in my life I listened! It's been approximately 2 months and my box turtle is back to eating not it's normal diet but way more food than what it used to!  I just want to say THANK YOU for helping my box turtle. I do recommend this exotic pet medical Center if your pet is not feeling well just take them in. Save your pet's life and save yourself the tears, don't wait... Bring them here!

Called to inquire about bird health certificates and possible vaccines needed. Receptionists seemed uncertain regarding what was needed and projected that uncertainty on me, a potential client, calling for professional expertise. I stated more than twice that I was uncertain about vaccine requirements but could call back if the info is needed to set an appointment. Receptionist stated that I needed to obtain info from a “Pet locating service” which is untrue. Utilizing a pet relocating service is not a requirement to travel.  Again, I stated that I needed a health certificate and possible vaccines. I reiterated that I was not certain if and what vaccines were needed but could call back with the information. After her nice-nasty responses I became frustrated because it was clear that she is lazy, judgmental, and committed to not being of service.

Maybe my dogs veterinarian spoils them because they advised me on the precise regulations, vaccines, and overall requirements my pets needed to fly. This lady was annoyed that I, the potential client, was calling her without fully understanding the scope of something I’ve never done before. It’s not every day that a person flies with their birds! Word to the wise: EACH AIRLINE HAS THEIR OWN REQUIREMENTS, USA HAS THEIR OWN REQUIREMENTS, AND THE COUNTRY YOU’RE TRAVELING TO HAS ANOTHER SET OF REQUIREMENTS. And they each recommend that you call the other to be sure you meet all requirements. My intention was to schedule an appointment to confirm that my birds are healthy enough to fly and get them the vaccines needed that a professional veterinarian can easily advise.

I found her attitude to be passive aggressive and it was clear that she does not have adequate listening skills. This is more of an, “It’s not what you say but how you say it.”

No way the five star reviews are authentic.

Dr. Bjornebo is a great veterinarian who uses her time and expertise to help not only her own clients and patients, but actively and willingly consults with veterinarians around the country to help with education and appropriate treatment of their cases. I am extremely grateful for her help in caring for my exotic patients.
Kind and caring staff experts at what they do
We are grateful for your five-star rating! Your trust in Tree of Life Exotic Pet Medical Center means everything.

The staff and doctor here are truly amazing, I would not go to any other exotic pet hospital in Arizona. Despite the drive they are like no other. Thank you guys for everything.
-Pascal
Absolutely excellent for both well-care advice and sick care. We brought our budgie here, but I would trust them with any species.
Very happy with Tree of Life. Appointment was easy to make. Upfront with costs. Very clean with compassionate staff. Thanks for taking care of Mango 🦜

I just recently moved to the area. My 9 year old ferret Poe went downhill pretty quickly. I took Poe to Tree Of Life to have him put to sleep. The staff was quick and compassionate. They took Poe and handled him with so much love and care. They were incredibly understanding and offered the best environment for my sweet Poe. After Poe had passed i received a letter in the mail from them offering their condolences which ment so much to me. Poe was an amazing ferret and it ment so much to me that their staff was so supportive and loving during this process ❤️  pictures of my sweet old man for the memories ❤️
Our guinea pig had an eye injury, so we took him to this office. They were very friendly and handled out guinea pig well. His eye is better now thanks to this office!

They were great... they care for my jenny, parrot 🦜 with lots of care. She is very healthy, just changing some of Her foods.
This will be Jenny's Dr's. 🙂
We are glad to hear from you, Lee. Thank you for choosing Tree of Life Exotic Pet Medical Center.

Simply the best veterinary clinic I've ever been to. Dr B, is the best always takes the time to explain everything in detail. Staff is very friendly and truly loves the animals. Always  patient with my birds craziness.

Treated our baby with such care! We were nervous about a huge vet bill, but TOL was so reasonably priced in comparison to other exotic vets in the area. We were grateful that they had availability. Luckily they were able to diagnose him and get him feeling better. Nopal sends his thanks!!
Excellent, caring team and beautiful new facility! Couldn't recommend Dr. Bjornebo highly enough.
Thank you to Dr. Bjornebo and Johnny for everything you did for Jellybean and I. Your compassion and care means more to me than you will ever know! 🤍 🪽 …
Doctor was thorough in her communication of my turtle's health and care
They took very good care of our pet chicken.  Highly recommend.

I have a 2 year old axolotl and he has a growth on his hind leg. When I was transporting him he tore his tail and I freaked out… I took him here and my experience was 10/10. The staff is so kind and caring, Dr. B is knowledgeable and actually cares about your pet. The staff here didn’t treat my pet as a “fish” but as a patient with a worried momma. The pricing is so reasonable, less than what I was expecting and WAY less then an ER or a certain other exotic animal hospital.. The staff here cares and they all want to help you. Shout out to Johnny for going the extra mile and putting a cold tub of RO water in the fridge for when we got there!! That was an awesome nice touch that we weren’t expecting! 10/10. Take your exotic pet here.

After getting our new Ball Python, she started showing signs of respiratory distress and infection. Dr. B and her team were very knowledgeable and validating and treated her with the utmost care over the 2 month period it took to bring her back to her normal self. After a few failed attempts with certain antibiotics, she found one that stuck!

They were very accommodating to our schedule and if she was showing any distress, they were only a call away.

We had a few big scares, and they spent extra time with us to go over our options and make sure we had all the information we needed to make informed decisions.

-As far as I know, and was told, they do NOT offer payment plan options-

Very clean office and VERY friendly staff <3

We appreciate you all, and Rocky says thankssss!
Very knowledgeable veterinarian with a definite passion for exotic pets!

Sadly, I had to bring my corn snake in for burns she sustained in her enclosure. The whole team was awesome and I felt like we were in great hands. Risshan at the front desk was welcoming, friendly and pleasant! The technician, Johnny, was friendly and thorough while getting the history and gentle while handling my little Louise.  He demonstrated how to give her medications and was very knowledgeable. Dr. Bjornebo was awesome! She explained everything to me in a way I understood and gave me a lot of information on how to take care of the burns and recommendations for a new heat source. I left with not just medications and a care plan, but so much information and most importantly the feeling that I 100% went to the right place. Highly recommend this hospital! Thanks to the whole team!

Amanda and Louise 🐍🖤

We brought our pet in to be seen with concerns about their health. We were met with condescension from the vet and dismissal of concerns. We were told to contact them if we felt things were worse. We did and we were told to wait 4 more days before they would act on our concerns and that they weren’t too concerned and have “seen it often”. Day 3 my pet died. I have absolutely no idea where these 5 star reviews come from, and it makes me wonder their validity, but they deserve 0 stars. It was my fault for trusting this “expert” though. Absolutely more concerned with upping the bill than helping pets. Would recommend only if you hate your pet.
They were so gentle and loving with my guinea pigs. I'm glad they're so close so I can come to them whenever I need to.

Dr. Bjornebo is an exceptionally talented vet.  She has been taking care of my green iguanas for years from routine wellness checks to major medical cares & I am so grateful to have her.

It's very hard to find a good reptile vet. Dr. B & her team is absolute treasure for reptile enthusiasts in Arizona.

My female iggy just had spay surgery in the state of art clinic & she was treated with excellent cares & beyond.

I can not thank them enough. The Best Clinic in Arizona !!!

Here is a picture of her on the way to the clinic for surgery follow-up.

This group of people is absolutely AMAZING! Dr. Bjornebo is very knowledgeable about exotic animals and has been a God sent for me and my beardie Mango. Special thanks to Dr. Bjornebo, Johnny, and Risshan for all their help, compassion, and support. I have been spreading the word to my exotic animal friend groups, so expect some new patients!
Very helpful and affordable vet for lizards. Staff was very personable and focused on health of the animal without being crazy expensive.

Not our usual vet but we had to call and schedule a last minute emergency appointment as our beloved guy was showing very distressing signs. Upon arrival he was immediately taken back for stabilization and treated with the utmost care. Unfortunately he didn’t make it but the staff and Dr B broke the news in such a respectful and compassionate way. They stayed with us after closing while the rest of the family drove out to say our last goodbyes. While the tragedy of his passing will always be with us; the compassion, respect, and handling of the situation will be as well. Thank you Dr B and all of the staff, you made the differences you could and that’s not overlooked. I highly recommend Tree of Life and will be switching our other reptiles care to them.

Had an emergency for our pet. They acted quickly, but unfortunately, our pet didn't make it. They were respectful about the aftercare and gave options. I'm glad we came here compared to somewhere else.
Veterinary staff are extremely loving kind and patient.  The doctor really knows her stuff and the animals seem to connect!
Dr. B is the best! She is very knowledgeable, thorough, caring, and compassionate for her patients and people who own them. She has always been truthful and dependable to help my critters.

A rescued desert tortoise was taken to Dr Bjornebo after months of neglect, improper medical care, and subpar living conditions. She really took her time to evaluate the situation and provide proper pain control prior to even attempting a thorough exam as to not further injure this kiddo. I really, really appreciated this since this guy had been through enough.
After removal of the poorly placed epoxy patch, he was found to have multiple different...hitchhikers under the dead shell underneath. After the insects were removed, Bjornebo monitored him for any signs of shock or distress. He appeared to be doing well and was sent home with medications!
This guy is now living his best life in a huge outdoor area with plenty of grass and sunshine.
Dr. B and her staff are a godsend to reptile owners. The combination of her extensive knowledge and compassion for these sweet creatures is un matched.
10/10 recommend.
Dr.B will be our vet for life!! She has so much passion and love for her work and the animals. Couldn’t recommend this place more ♥️♥️♥️

Dr Bjornebo is such a great Dr. She treated our Chameleon. He was having a hard time with one of his eyes. She knew exactly what to do, and prescribed us what he needed to be able to clear his eye issues. She is very kind and knowledgeable. I would go see her again if I need anything for my exotic pets. I recommend her to anyone I know in need of care for their babies as well.

If I could give this place 6 stars I would. Caring, compassionate, and super knowledgeable staff. If you have an exotic pet that needs wellness care or is sick, this is the best place to go! Dr. Bjornebo and her staff are there to provide the best exotic pet care in Arizona!

Dr Bjornebo is one of the most knowledgeable and caring exotic veterinarians in the Phoenix area. We have been taking our bunnies to her for years and are so excited to be able to visit her at her own practice. Highly recommend her and her team for care of exotic pets!

Dr. Bjornebo is one of the most knowledgeable vets I’ve ever met . Not only is she exceptionally caring , but she continues her education constantly , annd educates others .  As a client , I’m really fortunate to have her as a vet . Her state of the art facility for exotic pets is a real gift to the valley.

I am an exotic animal veterinarian in California. I routinely turn to Dr. Bjornebo for advice on the weird cases I cannot figure out. If you have an exotic animal in this practice's area, I strongly recommend her!
Dr. B is the best! So excited for her to have her own clinic!

Phenomenal exotics specialist and surgeon. She took excellent care of our rhinoceros rat snake wil ultrasound, facial abscess on our eastern diamondback, and mass removal on our green iguana. Can't express the amount of relief and excitement I have to use Dr. B and her hospital for all our exotics needs in the future, even the most difficult cases.

Are you hesitant to make the switch to a new clinic for exotics care? Don't be!! Dr. Bjornebo is one of the tip top very best reptile vets out here. I am very glad she finally has her own clinic, and even though it is a drive for me (I live in peoria) it is 100% worth it for the knowledge and skill she posesses. Specialists make a world of a difference. She has been taking care of my dozens of scaley critters for over 5 years now and shes the best at what she does. She is very knowledgeable about tons of species of reptiles and amphibians, (heck, even invertebrates and any and all kinds of creepy crawlies!) and I trust her with my 6 various species of large constrictors, and dont have to worry about them getting hurt by mishandling, or anyone getting bit. She always has an educational answer for you, and always made me laugh whenever I saw her in office. She's truly a gem! Thank you for taking such good care of them! Congratulations on the new office, Bj! It's beautiful! So glad I have a place that I can take these big kiddos to that is knowledgeable of the species, and understanding/kind! (not even just Bjornebo, her staff as well!)
One of the best exotic docs there is!
